member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.MediaTags.MediaTagWriteOptions.WriteId3v1Tag
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether an ID3v1 tag is appended to MP3 files. The default is .
member.remarks: An ID3v1 tag stores at most 30 Latin-1 characters per field, so it silently truncates values that an ID3v2 tag represents in full. It is written by default because some players read nothing else.

member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.MediaTags.MediaTagWriteOptions.Id3v2PaddingSize
member.summary: Gets or sets the number of padding bytes appended to a written ID3v2 tag. The default is 1024.
member.remarks: Padding lets another tagger grow the tag later without rewriting the whole file. Set it to 0 to produce the smallest possible tag.
